action: The cord pulls taut and trembles, the dolls jerk, needles glint, the tags flutter and smoke peels off in a loop. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: VOODOO LINK santet tether, a horizontal side-view strip across a wide short canvas: a taut black cord running from the LEFT end to the RIGHT end, two small black cloth dolls tied on the cord at each end pierced with needles, small talisman cloth tags and gold beads along the cord, grey smoke peeling off. Indonesian black magic folk horror (santet, dukun) style: physical ritual objects, thick grey-white benzoin incense smoke, jasmine and frangipani petals, black cloth and talisman cloth strips with original ornamental Javanese-style glyph strokes (decorative, not readable), wavy keris blades with damascus pamor patterns, batik parang and kawung ornament, wayang kulit leather shadow-puppet silhouettes. NOT Thai, NOT Chinese, NOT Japanese, NOT anime: no neon beams, no crystals, no lightning, no clean glowing magic circles, no paper ofuda, no sparkle stars. Ominous and eerie, NOT cute. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, classic elevated three-quarter MMORPG view, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side, no blood, no gore, no skulls, no readable script, no floor texture, no text.
